title: feat(spec,ui): an inline object-metric tile declares polarity, so a lower-is-better KPI draws a rise red
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ84mGMAxEKq4h2AUS2QAB3o4)_
Fixes #27347

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added (object-metric polarity)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:页面级 `object-metric` 指标卡新增可声明的 `polarity`(`higher` / `lower` / `neutral`,与数据集度量同一词表),趋势徽标(`compareTo` 计算的或静态 `trend`)按它着色。
- 为什么改:内联指标卡只按方向着色,"越低越好"的指标(平均周转天数)上涨 23% 被画成绿色,与同一看板上数据集指标卡的颜色相反,是读错数。
- 风险与回滚:不声明时颜色与现在逐字节一致(测试钉住类名字符串);只新增一个可选键,回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` 的 `object-metric` 段(新键与拒收提示);`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/MetricWidget.tsx` 的徽标着色一行;`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/utils.ts` 的共享 `deltaToneClass`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/ObjectMetricWidget.polarity-27347.test.tsx`,预期 7 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:涉及发布的 spec 与 `skills/**`(Tier H),契约复核 PASS 与席位 ACCEPT 之后再批准合入。

## What changes

- **Spec** (`ObjectMetricPropsSchema`, the `ComponentPropsMap['object-metric']` row): an optional top-level `polarity`, the dataset measure's own `DatasetMeasurePolarity` by reference (no second spelling, no new export). Any other value is refused at the key. `betterWhen` / `goodDirection` / `trendDirection` are aliased to `polarity`. A top-level `direction` gets a prescription naming both keys it could mean (`trend.direction` for the static badge's arrow, `polarity` for good news), because on this tile the dataset measure's `direction` alias would send an author who meant the badge arrow to the wrong key. `higherIsBetter` / `lowerIsBetter` get the three values.
- **Top-level, not inside `compareTo`**: the badge `MetricWidget` draws is `derivedTrend ?? trend`, and the static `trend` badge was coloured by direction alone too, so one key covers the computed and the static badge. The reason is in the key's docblock.
- **Renderer** (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`): `deltaToneClass` moved from `DatasetWidget.tsx` to `utils.ts` (one colouring rule, now also answering "no tone" for a static badge with no `direction`). `ObjectMetricWidget` forwards `polarity`; `MetricWidget` colours the badge through `deltaToneClass` and mutes it under `neutral`. Both prop types name the key by reference (`ObjectMetricProps['polarity']`). The `object-metric` registration publishes an enum input; `sdui.manifest.json` regenerated.
- **Undeclared keeps today's colours exactly**: the class string is pinned byte for byte. Nothing infers a polarity from the aggregated field's name.
- **Generated**: `authorable-surface/ui.json`, `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx`, `sdui.manifest.json` + its record, and `content/docs/ui/components/index.mdx` / `plugins.mdx` (`gen-sdui-reference`). `liveness/page.json` row `regions` gains evidence entry `[121] object-metric.polarity` (read points cited in-repo with symbol anchors).
- **Skills** (`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`, Tier H): the metric-widget bullet says an inline `object-metric` declares its own `polarity`.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` minor, `@objectstack/skills` patch.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ui/object-metric-polarity.test.ts`: the three values parse and keep their value; the member IS `DatasetMeasurePolarity` (identity); absent materializes nothing; `up` / `down` / `good` / `inverse` / `true` refused at the key; the three aliases point at `polarity`; top-level `direction` names `trend` and `polarity`; the two boolean-flag spellings get the values; a tsc pin (`@ts-expect-error` on `polarity: 'up'`).
- `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/ObjectMetricWidget.polarity-27347.test.tsx`, through the registered `object-metric` block: `lower` rise drawn bad and fall drawn good with the arrow kept; `higher` as before; `neutral` muted both ways; CONTROL undeclared class strings byte-identical (field named `turnaround_days`); the static `trend` badge coloured by the same key; CONTROL a static badge with no `direction` takes no tone.

## Acceptance notes

- `@object-ui/types` has no diff: `ObjectMetricBlockSchema` takes the spec row by reference (`propsBag('object-metric', SpecObjectMetricPropsSchema)`), and `ObjectMetricBlockNode` derives from that arm, so the key reaches the ui zod face and the authoring type with no edit there. No `@object-ui/types` changeset row, since the package's own files do not change.
- The near-miss alias map and the not-a-flag prescription are declared on the tile rather than shared with `dataset.zod.ts`: a shared constant would be a new public export (`ui/index.ts` re-exports `dataset.zod` whole) or a new module outside the claimed file surface.
- Skills token ratchet: `rules/dashboards.md` 6214 to 6216 tokens of ceiling 6221 (no raise). Paid by cutting the bullet's `options.trend` reaches no renderer clause, whose surviving home is the same file's Widget `options` section (a dataset-bound widget's `trend` styles nothing).
